sentences.en: In the Bouteflika years, Algeria experienced a great economic boom.
sentences.zh: 1. 在布特弗利卡执政时期，阿尔及利亚经历了一次重大的经济繁荣。

sentences.en: The industry has seen many booms and busts in the past.
sentences.zh: 2. 这个行业在过去经历了许多起伏波动。

sentences.en: We have been visited by a nation-wide economic boom.
sentences.zh: 3. 我们见证了一场席卷全国的经济繁荣。
